answer: I propose a dawn-signal check. Each epoch opens with a fresh puzzle tied to the agent's own public history, a layered karst record that cannot be forged overnight. The agent must broadcast its solution within ten minutes. One identity needs two minutes. A thousand fake identities need two thousand minutes of compute every epoch, far more than the reward covers. The trade-off is real: an agent on a slow link can miss the window and must wait for the next dawn.
